specification.title: Kassir
specification.description: A Tauri v2 desktop cashier application (Point of Sale) for Windows. Manages products, transactions, customers, cash flow, and analytics. Offline-first with bidirectional timestamp-based sync to a cloud backend. Includes thermal receipt printing, role-based access (admin/user), and multi-cashier login.

command.name: hash_password
command.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt with DEFAULT_COST. Returns the hash string.

command.name: verify_password
command.signature: async fn(password: String, hash: String) → Result<bool, AuthError>
command.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a bcrypt hash. Returns true if matching.

command.name: encode_jwt
command.signature: fn(name: String, role: String) → Result<String, JwtError>
command.description: Encodes a JWT (HS256) with UserClaims { name, role: Role, exp }. Expiry is 5 days from now. Secret key is hardcoded "super_secret_coy".

command.name: decode_jwt
command.description: Decodes and validates a JWT (HS256). Returns UserClaims { name, role, exp }.

command.name: get_printers
command.description: Enumerates all Windows printer devices via winprint::PrinterDevice::all(). Returns list of { name, status: "Ready" }. Returns error if no printers found.

command.name: print_pdf
command.signature: fn(printer_name: String, pdf_bytes: Vec<u8>) → Result<String, String>
command.description: Prints raw PDF bytes to a named Windows printer. Validates PDF header (%PDF). Saves bytes to a NamedTempFile, prints via WinPdfPrinter with default PrintTicket, then deletes temp file.

error.message: Invalid PDF: missing PDF header. First N bytes: {header}

jwt.description: HS256 JWT with 5-day expiry. Claims: { name: String, role: Role (admin|user), exp: i64 }. Secret key: hardcoded "super_secret_coy". Role enum serializes as lowercase strings. gen_new_token refreshes token if within 2 days of expiry.

database.name: data.db
database.description: 41 SQL migrations managed by tauri-plugin-sql. Schema evolved from simple INTEGER PK tables to TEXT (ULID) primary keys with updated_at/sync_at timestamps for cloud sync. Key evolution: - Migrations 1-10: Initial tables (products, records, record_items), add discount/credit/capital - Migrations 11-20: Barcode to TEXT, capital fixes, cashier with password, records redesign - Migrations 21-30: Price/capital to REAL, images, socials, money, payment methods - Migrations 31-40: Refactor to TEXT PKs (ULID), product_events (event-sourced stock), sync columns - Migration 41: Add money_kind_ordering column

database.name: tx.db
database.description: 6 SQL migrations for transactional state (active POS transaction tabs). Schema: - transactions: Active tabs with mode, query, fix, method, note, customer, product/extra input state - products: Line items per tab (product_id, name, barcode, price, qty, created_at) - extras: Extra charges per tab (extra_id, name, value, kind, is_saved flag) - discounts: Per-product discounts (disc_id, disc_value, disc_kind: percent/number/pcs) - Migration 6: Changed product_order to product_created_at (timestamp ordering)

embedded_api.endpoint: Runs SELECT 1 against SQLite. Returns "OK" or "Database error".

endpoint.description: Authenticates with { name, password }. Queries cashiers table for user, verifies bcrypt hash. Returns JWT token on success, or { error: "Nama dan/atau kata sandi salah" } on failure.
Validates JWT from X-Header-Token header. Returns session { name, role } with refreshed token if needed. Returns null session if invalid/missing token.
endpoint.response: { token: String | null, session: { name: String, role: "admin"|"user" } | null }

endpoint.description: Lists products updated after ?timestamp (default 0). Requires X-Header-Token auth. Returns { token, products: Product[] }.
endpoint.response: { token: String, products: [{ id, name, price, stock, stock_back, barcode?, capital, note, updated_at }] }

endpoint.description: Creates or updates a product. If id is provided, updates existing; otherwise inserts new. Checks barcode uniqueness (returns error if duplicate barcode). Requires X-Header-Token auth.
endpoint.body: { id?: i64, name: String, price: f64, stock: i64, stock_back: i64, barcode?: String, capital: f64, note: String }

token_refresh.description: gen_new_token() refreshes the JWT if the current token expires within 2 days (now + 2*24*3600 > claims.exp). Otherwise returns the existing token unchanged.

middleware.description: Checks auth.get() for a stored user. If undefined, throws redirect("/login"). Applied to the authenticated layout (all routes except /login).

middleware.name: admin
middleware.description: Checks auth.user().role === "admin". If not admin, throws redirect("/setting"). Applied to: cashier, customer, method, money, social routes.

layout.name: AuthLayout
layout.description: Authenticated layout wrapper. Activates navigation shortcuts via useNavigationShortcuts(). Renders: sticky Topbar (sky-300 background, h-16/h-12 responsive), main-body div (flex-1), Outlet, and Toaster (sonner) for notifications.

component.name: Topbar
component.description: Sticky header bar. Left: back button (when not on home), route title (h1, text-3xl), and dynamic Title component. Right: TopNavList (desktop tab navigation) and action buttons (settings gear, refresh). Route titles: Beranda, Toko, Stok, Riwayat, Uang, Analisis, Pengaturan, Metode, Pelanggan, Kasir, Kontak.

component.name: TopNavList
component.description: Desktop-only (md:flex) tab bar navigation. Shows Toko (alt+0), Stok (alt+1), Riwayat (alt+2), and Uang (alt+3, admin only). Active tab gets white background with rounded top corners and border. Navigates with ?url_back=/ search param for back navigation context.

component.name: Refresh
component.description: Refresh button (RefreshCcw icon). Calls db.customer.revalidate(), db.extra.revalidate(), db.image.revalidate(), db.method.revalidate(), db.product.revalidate(), db.social.revalidate(), then window.location.reload().

component.name: SettingLink
component.description: Settings gear icon button (alt+4 shortcut indicator). Navigates to /setting. Active state shows secondary variant.

keyboard_shortcuts.description: Alt+number shortcuts for navigation (registered in useNavigationShortcuts). Pressing Alt toggles shortcut hint badges (Kbd components) visible for 5 seconds via @xstate/store atom.

error_boundary.description: Global ErrorBoundary component catches route errors. Handles: Unauthenticated → redirect /login (hard). Route error responses (404, 403) with contextual icons (FileQuestion, ShieldAlert). Generic errors with stack trace display (DEV only). Provides Muat Ulang, Kembali, Home actions.

auth_module.description: Module at src/lib/auth.ts. Stores user { id, name, role } in localStorage as "user". In-memory cache via _user variable. auth.get() returns cached or parsed localStorage value. auth.set() updates both. auth.user() throws Unauthenticated if no user. auth.hash() and auth.verify() invoke Tauri Rust commands wrapped in Effect. User schema validated with Zod: { id: nonempty string, name: string, role: "admin"|"user" }.

shared_components.component: Role-based conditional render. If role !== "admin", shows Redirect to given path.

ui_primitives.description: shadcn/ui primitives built on Radix UI, located in src/components/ui/. Style: new-york, baseColor: zinc, icons: lucide.

Data table with header, body, row, cell.

connection.description: Singleton pattern via Effect-TS. Database.load("sqlite:data.db") on first access, cached globally. On query error, closes and resets connection. All operations wrapped in Effect for typed error handling (DbError). Uses raw SQL with parameterized queries (no ORM).
connection.type: Custom error class with _tag = "DbError" wrapping the underlying error.

caching.description: In-memory caching via cache-factory.ts. Entities with revalidate(): product, customer, method, extra, image, social. Cache is invalidated on mutations and on manual refresh (topbar Refresh button). Product cache is also invalidated after record commit.

transaction_tx_db.description: Separate tx.db database for active POS transaction state (tab-based). Not synced.

record_commit.description: addOne() in src/database/record/add/one.ts commits a full transaction as a single BEGIN/COMMIT block. Steps: (1) get product stock data, (2) insert record row, (3) upsert customer, (4) insert extras, (5) calculate effective capital per product, (6) update product stock and create product_events, (7) insert new products if needed, (8) insert record_products and discounts. On success, invalidates product cache.

cloud_api.description: Effect-TS based HTTP client (src/lib/reqwest.ts) wrapping @tauri-apps/plugin-http fetch. API base URL from VITE_API_URL env var (dev: http://192.168.225.187:8787, prod: https://api.kassir.store). All requests use Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Responses validated with Zod schemas. Error types: RequestError (network), ResponseError (non-2xx), BodyError (JSON parse), ZodSchemaError (validation).

state_management.description: Two storage layers: (1) @tauri-apps/plugin-store for persistent KV storage (store.json), (2) @xstate/store for reactive in-memory atoms. Both wrapped in Effect-TS for typed error handling.

persistent_store.entry: Cloud API sync token (string). Managed by store.sync.token.
Toggle cashier name display (boolean as string).

store_modules.module: Shop info: address, footer, header, owner, showCashier. get() reads all 5 keys concurrently. set.basic() and set.showCashier() update individual keys.
Printer name and receipt width get/set.

sync_system.description: Timestamp-based bidirectional sync. Each entity (product, product-event, record, method, grave) follows the same pattern: pull → merge → push. Uses stored last-pull timestamps to fetch only delta changes. Pull fetches count + data concurrently. Merge compares server updatedAt vs local updated_at to determine insert vs update. Push uploads unsynced items and marks them synced on server confirmation. Grave sync handles deletion tombstones bidirectionally. All sync operations are Effect-based with comprehensive error handling.

sync_flow.stage: GET /api/product/count/{ts} + GET /api/product/{ts} concurrently. Fetches all server products updated after last known timestamp.
For each server product: if no local match → insert. If local updated_at < server updatedAt → update. Tracks latest server updatedAt as new timestamp.
Gets unsynced local products. POST /api/product. On response, marks non-failed IDs as synced (concurrency: 50). Returns remaining unsync count.
Persists new last-pull timestamp via store.sync.product.set().

sync_flow.description: Syncs product_events after products (FK dependency). Posts product IDs to get relevant events.

sync_flow.stage: Insert/update records with nested products, extras, discounts.
GET /api/grave/{ts}. Returns products[] and records[] tombstone IDs.
Deletes local products and records matching tombstone IDs (db.product.del.sync, db.record.del.sync). Cleans up local grave entries for those IDs.
Collects local grave entries, DELETEs to /api/grave.

error_handling.case: Logs error via log.error(), returns error message.
Uses responseError.failMsg() to extract server error.
ZodSchemaError: logs validation issues, returns first 10 issue messages.

page.name: login
page.description: Two-mode login page. On mount, checks if cashiers exist in local DB. If none: shows FreshForm ("Buat Toko" — shop name, owner name, password). If cashiers exist: shows LoginForm (username + password dropdown/input). Loader checks auth.get() and redirects to /setting if already authenticated. Background: bg-zinc-950.

fresh_form.description: First-time setup. Creates first cashier (admin) and shop. On submit: invokes hash_password via Rust, encodes JWT, stores user in localStorage, navigates to home.

login_form.description: Returning user login. Dropdown list of cashier names. On submit: verifies password via Rust bcrypt, encodes JWT, stores user, navigates to /.

page.name: home
page.description: Dashboard landing page (index route). Shows: - Header: shop name + date - StatsGrid: summary statistics (today's sales, transaction count, etc.) - NavGrid: icon navigation grid for main sections

page.name: shop
page.description: Point of Sale — the primary transaction interface. Tab-based layout. Each tab is an independent transaction stored in tx.db. Left panel shows product/extra list with fuzzy search (fuzzysort). Right panel shows active tab's transaction: product line items with qty/price/discount, extras, summary with totals, payment method selection, pay amount with change calculation. Supports sell and buy modes. Transaction state persists in tx.db across app restarts. On first load, if no tabs exist, creates a default sell tab.

modes.mode: Standard sales. Reduces product stock on commit.
Purchase/restock. Increases product stock on commit.

complete_flow.description: On payment: shows complete dialog with change amount. Option to print receipt (PDF generated via pdf-lib, printed via Windows printer). Clears tab after completion. Transaction committed as atomic BEGIN/COMMIT block (record.add.one).

receipt.description: PDF receipt generated with pdf-lib + @pdf-lib/fontkit. Contains: header (shop name, address, date), product table, extras, totals, payment info, footer (customizable text). Printed via winprint (Windows PDF printing).

drag_drop.description: Line items support drag-and-drop reordering via @dnd-kit (core, sortable, utilities).

page.name: stock
page.description: Inventory management. Tabbed view: Products + Extras. Searchable list with FAB for creating new. Products have: name, barcode (auto-generated), price, capital, stock, note, images. Product detail: edit form + stock history timeline (product_events) + image gallery (drag-drop upload, reorder). Stock can be incremented/decremented manually (logs product_event).

subpages.subpage: Product detail: Info tab, Stock History tab, Images tab.
Create extra form (name, value, kind: number/percent).

page.name: records
page.description: Transaction history. Paginated list with filters: date range, method, customer name/phone, mode. Each row shows: paid_at date, method badge, total, cashier name, mode indicator (sell/buy), credit status. Record detail: full transaction view with line items, extras, payment info, customer info. Actions: edit note, change mode, toggle credit, change payment method.

page.name: money
page.description: Cash flow tracking (admin only). Manages money kinds (categories) and money entries. Each money kind has: name, type (absolute = manual entry, change = computed from others), ordering. Money entries: value, timestamp, note. Linked to a money kind. Layout: left panel (kinds list with add/edit/delete/reorder), right panel (entries grouped by kind).

subpages.subpage: Money history for a specific kind.

page.name: analytics
page.description: Reports dashboard with sub-navigation tabs. All sub-pages use shared interval picker (daily/weekly/monthly) and date range picker for time-based filtering.

subpages.subpage: Income vs expense graph over time. Summary panel with totals.
Net profit/loss analysis. Revenue minus costs graph.
Sales distribution by hour/day. Bar chart with peak analysis.
Per-product sales table: name, qty sold, revenue, profit. Sortable, searchable, paginated.
Credit/debt tracking table: customer, outstanding credit, total debt. Sortable.
User profile: name display, password change.
Shop info: name, address, receipt header/footer, show cashier toggle.
Printer selection (enumerate Windows printers) and receipt width.
Manual sync trigger with per-entity status display.

page.name: cashier
page.description: Cashier account management (admin only). CRUD for cashier accounts: name, role (admin/user), password.

page.name: customer
page.description: Customer records (admin only). CRUD for customers: name, phone. Synced to cloud.

page.name: method
page.description: Payment method management (admin only). CRUD for methods: name, kind (cash/transfer/debit/qris). Supports soft delete. Synced to cloud.

page.name: social
page.description: Social/store profile (admin only). Key-value entries: name, value. Synced to cloud.
